notes:
- Crash reports, and they are off until you say otherwise: The comment sheet has been force-closing while it loads a thread, and the report that comes back is the sentence "it closes when loading the comments" - which is true and unfixable, because a force-stop leaves nothing behind once the system dialog is dismissed and reading the source can only rule a line out. So the next crash can now leave a note: the exception, its stack, the app version and the device model, written to the app's own private storage. It is off by default. Settings > Info > Diagnostics has the switch, the last report when there is one, and Copy / Show / Clear; nothing is ever uploaded, and turning the switch off deletes whatever was stored. If you are reporting a bug, turn it on, reproduce the crash, then come back to that card.
- The app says where it comes from: AniSequel is installed from GitHub rather than a store, so Settings > Info > Help & links now carries the repository - the download page, the source and the release notes for the build in your hand - with the GitHub mark next to it, and a Report a problem row that opens the issue tracker. That is also where a copied crash report is meant to go.
- A posted reply scrolls to the right row: Posting a reply scrolls the sheet to it, and the scroll was one row short whenever the refresh above the list had failed: the list's first item is an error row in that case, not a reply, so the target index landed on the comment above the new one and left your own reply just off screen. The offset accounts for the error row now.
